name: expand-card
title: Expand Card
description: Select a collection to reveal its cover and details
useCases: In a collection list, a shopper opens a card, reads the details and returns to the overview.
In a workshop listing, an organizer puts the full session description behind a compact cover that visitors can expand.
task: Select a collection to reveal its cover and details
behavior: For one card pass title, body and cover. For a collection use items with content for each card.
